# The bare scheme is the library root: the packages, each imported by its own
# path. It declares nothing itself -- `button` is sngl:ui's, `color` is
# sngl:builtin's -- so it lists where to look rather than what it holds.
sngl doc sngl
stdout '# sngl'
stdout 'sngl:ui'
stdout 'sngl:builtin'
! stdout '\*\*button\*\*'
! stdout '\*\*color\*\*'

# Each tier is addressable on its own, and the two are disjoint.
sngl doc sngl:ui
stdout 'button'
! stdout '\*\*color\*\*'

sngl doc sngl:builtin
stdout 'color'
! stdout '\*\*button\*\*'

# The package set follows the lib/ directories, so an unknown one is named.
! sngl doc sngl:nope
stderr 'unknown stdlib package "nope"'

# A declaration asked of the root is answered by the package that declares it.
sngl doc sngl button
stdout '# button'

# An alias declared in the CWD's package resolves to the imported directory.
sngl doc w
stdout 'Counter'

# Local directory still indexes as before.
sngl doc ./widgets
stdout 'Counter'

# Unknown scheme surfaces an error (nonzero exit).
! sngl doc bogus://nope

# A declaration named without its package resolves through the packages, and
# says which one it found and what importing it costs — the name alone is not
# enough to write the program.
sngl doc circle
stdout 'sngl:ui/draw'
stdout 'import \. "sngl:ui/draw"'
stdout '# circle'

sngl doc button
stdout 'sngl:ui'
stdout 'import \. "sngl:ui"'

# Except in sngl:builtin, which is the one package needing no import.
sngl doc color
stdout 'sngl:builtin \(ambient\)'
! stdout 'import'


# $"..." lowers to a call on sngl:i18n, and the import names the package —
# not one particular alias for it.
sngl check aliased_i18n.sngl
stdout 'aliased_i18n.sngl: ok'

# The compiler's own tier is not reachable by a bare name.
! sngl doc StrUpper

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import w "./widgets"
component main node {
    w.Counter(count = 1)
}

window {
    main
}
-- widgets/widgets.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component Counter(count int) node {
    text { value = "count: ${count}" }
}

window {
}
-- aliased_i18n.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import tr "sngl:i18n"

component main node {
    var n int = 1
    text(value=$"hi {n}")
}

window {
    main
}
